The missing key is `rate`. `settings.json:2` has a typo, `"rat": 0.5`, so `SETTINGS.get("rate")` in `app/pricing.py:8` returns `None`.

The fix is to rename `"rat"` to `"rate"`. Until then, `app/report.py:9` (`rate * count`) will raise a `TypeError`.

I didn't remember the earlier trace, so I read the files again to answer this. I haven't modified anything.
